The Quiet Revolution in Language Learning

For decades, people learned languages from textbooks. Today, millions of learners immerse themselves in real content: videos, podcasts and articles written for native speakers.

Research suggests that comprehensible input is the key ingredient. When you understand most of what you read, your brain quietly absorbs grammar and vocabulary.
